categories.main_business_segments: Beijing Haohan Deep Information Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in network visualization, information security protection, and big data solutions. Its main products include intelligent collection management systems, intelligent application systems, internet information security management systems, and abnormal traffic monitoring and protection systems. The company also develops hardware and software products and provides technical services related to these areas.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary technologies such as large-scale high-speed DPI (Deep Packet Inspection) technology, PB-level big data processing platforms, large-scale network user perception and business quality analysis, large-scale network anomaly traffic and content detection, and virtualization-based cloud security management. It integrates FPGA chip design, virtualization, machine learning, and AI technologies, including AI large models, to enhance network visualization, security, and data governance. Production mainly involves assembling finished products and programming chips, with procurement of PCB boards and electronic components from qualified suppliers.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's key customers are primarily telecom operators, including the three major Chinese telecom operators, with China Mobile being the largest single customer. It also serves government and enterprise clients. The company’s products are widely deployed across backbone, interconnection, provincial networks, and IDC export points, playing a critical role in network management and security.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, covering major regions such as North China, Northeast, East China, South China, Central China, Northwest, and Southwest. It is expanding its overseas presence focusing on regions with close geopolitical ties to China, such as Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and Africa, to tap into growing network security demands.
categories.supply_chain_position: Beijing Haohan Deep operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on software and hardware development, system integration, and providing network visualization and security solutions. It procures electronic components and PCB boards from upstream suppliers and assembles and programs finished products before delivering to end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous R&D investment, focusing on AI integration, big data, network security, and virtualization technologies. It aims to enhance DPI capabilities, develop AI-powered network traffic analysis, encrypted traffic recognition, and deepfake detection systems. Strategic priorities include expanding in large network security, data element markets, intelligent applications, and promoting domestic substitution of core technologies. Collaboration with universities and research institutes is also a key part of its R&D strategy.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through sales of integrated network visualization and security solutions, including hardware and software products, as well as technical services such as data analysis and operation and maintenance support. Contracts are typically obtained via direct sales, bidding, single-source procurement, and business negotiations, with a significant portion from telecom operators.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in China's network visualization and information security market, recognized as a top-tier domestic provider with the capability to replace foreign products. It has a strong market share in telecom operator networks, especially in backbone and international interconnection points. Its competitive advantages include proprietary core technologies, extensive customer loyalty, and a comprehensive product and service portfolio.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 442 million, a 15% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 36 million, down 42.58%. Despite the decline, the company maintains a solid asset base with total assets of about RMB 1.39 billion and a net asset value of over RMB 1 billion. R&D investment increased to 25.46% of revenue, reflecting a focus on innovation. The company has a workforce of 662 employees, with 43% in R&D roles.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Beijing Haohan Deep emphasizes its deep technical expertise and proprietary technologies in DPI, big data, and AI to provide comprehensive, high-performance network visualization and security solutions. Its products offer superior functionality, performance, and cost-effectiveness compared to foreign competitors. The company’s integrated solutions enable large-scale, real-time traffic analysis, encrypted traffic recognition, and advanced threat detection, supporting customers’ digital transformation and security needs with a focus on innovation, reliability, and compliance.
